sensor: Thermal: vanadium oxide uncooled focal plane detector, 640x512, 17 um pixel pitch, 8-14 um, NETD < 35 mK; optical: 1/1.8in 4MP progressive-scan CMOS
features: thermal network hybrid speed dome (640x512 thermal + 4MP visible)
vanadium oxide uncooled thermal detector, NETD < 35 mK
thermal lens 25/35/50 mm; visible 45x optical zoom (5.5-248 mm)
pan 0 to 360, tilt -27 to +90, 3D positioning, 300 presets
visible IR illumination 150 m, auto rain-sensing wiper
IVS: tripwire, intrusion; boat, engineering-truck, heat and smoke detection
release_notes: Ultra-series hybrid thermal speed dome pairing a 640x512 uncooled VOx thermal channel with a 4MP 45x-zoom visible channel, 3D positioning and 150 m IR for wide-area perimeter surveillance.

frigate.notes: Dahua RTSP convention; channel 1 = visible, channel 2 = thermal. Not verified against a live unit.

home_assistant.notes: Dahua ONVIF (default port 80). Thermal and visible exposed as separate channels; PTZ via ONVIF.
